title: Sliding Window Maximum
hints: Taking max over each window is O(nk). A max-heap of (value, index) with lazy deletion (pop while the top index has left the window) gives O(n log n); that is already a respectable answer.

For O(n): when a new element arrives, any older element that is smaller can never be a window maximum again, because the new one outlives it. So the candidates, oldest to newest, have decreasing values.

Keep a deque of indices with decreasing values. For each i: pop from the back while nums[back] <= nums[i], push i, pop the front if it is <= i - k, and once i >= k - 1 the front is the window maximum.
